words.enDefinition: money lent to a student, or for their education, that must normally be repaid

examples.en: I looked up the remaining balance on my student loan while updating my budget.
examples.zh: 我更新预算时查了「学生贷款」还欠多少。

examples.en: Her student loan covered part of the course fees for the first year.
examples.zh: 她的「学生贷款」付了第一年课程费的一部分。

collocations: the balance of a student loan

words.enDefinition: a loan designed specifically to cover some or all of a student's tuition charges

examples.en: The UK funding notice listed a tuition fee loan beside my maintenance loan.
examples.zh: 英国资助通知把「学费贷款」列在生活费贷款旁边。

examples.en: I checked whether the tuition fee loan amount matched the bill from my university.
examples.zh: 我核对了「学费贷款」的金额是否与学校的账单一致。

collocations: apply for a tuition fee loan

words.enDefinition: a student loan in the UK designed to help with living expenses while studying

examples.en: The funding letter showed the maintenance loan as three separate payments for the year.
examples.zh: 资助信把「英国学生生活费贷款」列为当年分三笔发放。

examples.en: She compared her maintenance loan with the cost of rent and food near campus.
examples.zh: 她把「英国学生生活费贷款」和校园附近的房租、餐费对比了一下。

words.enDefinition: a student loan intended to help fund study at postgraduate level

examples.en: The adviser asked which postgraduate loan appeared in my funding application for next year.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的下一年资助申请里填的是哪种「研究生贷款」。

examples.en: My postgraduate loan appeared under a different heading from my previous undergraduate funding.
examples.zh: 我的「研究生贷款」显示在与以前本科资助不同的栏目下。

words.enDefinition: a student loan offered by a private lender instead of a public student aid program

examples.en: The guide compared a private student loan with the government loan in the example.
examples.zh: 指南对案例中的「私人机构学生贷款」和政府贷款做了比较。

examples.en: I contacted the lender listed next to the private student loan on my statement.
examples.zh: 我联系了报表上「私人机构学生贷款」旁边列的放贷机构。

collocations: take out a private student loan

words.enDefinition: a student loan provided through a federal government program

examples.en: The US workshop used a federal student loan to explain how the account works.
examples.zh: 美国讲座用一笔「联邦学生贷款」来解释这个账户怎样运作。

examples.en: I checked which organization manages the federal student loan shown in my account.
examples.zh: 我查了账号里显示的「联邦学生贷款」由哪个机构管理。

collocations: apply for a federal student loan
eligibility for a federal student loan

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦贴息学生贷款
words.enDefinition: a US federal student loan for eligible undergraduates on which the government pays interest during specified periods
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦贴息学生贷款

examples.en: My US aid offer listed the Direct Subsidized Loan under undergraduate funding options.
examples.zh: 我的美国资助通知把「美国联邦贴息学生贷款」列在本科资助选项下。

examples.en: The adviser explained why interest was not added to that Direct Subsidized Loan during enrolment.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么在读期间，那笔「美国联邦贴息学生贷款」没有新增利息。

collocations: qualify for a Direct Subsidized Loan
interest on a Direct Subsidized Loan

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦非贴息学生贷款
words.enDefinition: a US federal student loan on which the borrower is responsible for interest from disbursement
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦非贴息学生贷款

examples.en: I found the Direct Unsubsidized Loan listed separately on my American aid offer.
examples.zh: 我发现美国的资助通知把「美国联邦非贴息学生贷款」单独列出。

examples.en: The balance of my Direct Unsubsidized Loan included interest from while I was studying.
examples.zh: 我的「美国联邦非贴息学生贷款」余额包含在校期间的利息。

collocations: interest on a Direct Unsubsidized Loan

words.enDefinition: a US federal loan offered to eligible parents of dependent undergraduate students

examples.en: My father asked whether the Parent PLUS Loan would appear in his own account.
examples.zh: 我爸问，「美国父母PLUS贷款」会不会显示在他自己的账号里。

examples.en: The university put the Parent PLUS Loan in a section for family borrowing.
examples.zh: 学校把「美国父母PLUS贷款」放在了面向家庭的借款栏目。

collocations: apply for a Parent PLUS Loan

words.enDefinition: a credit facility that lets a student borrow as needed up to an approved limit

examples.en: The bank statement showed how much remained available on the student line of credit.
examples.zh: 银行对账单上显示了「学生信用额度」还有多少可用。

examples.en: The adviser compared a student line of credit with a fixed student loan.
examples.zh: 顾问把「学生信用额度」和固定金额的学生贷款做了比较。

collocations: apply for a student line of credit
draw on a student line of credit
a student line of credit limit

words.enDefinition: a lender's agreement to remove a cosigner's responsibility for a loan

examples.en: The lender explained which section of the form was for a cosigner release.
examples.zh: 放贷机构说明了表格哪一栏用来申请「解除共同签署义务」。

examples.en: The letter confirmed approval of the cosigner release for the private student loan.
examples.zh: 这封信确认，私人机构学生贷款的「解除共同签署义务」申请获批。

words.enDefinition: the date on which loan or aid money is or will be released

examples.en: I checked the disbursement date before asking the office about the late payment.
examples.zh: 我先查了「款项发放日期」，再去问办公室款项为什么没按时到账。

examples.en: The email listed a new disbursement date for the winter term award.
examples.zh: 邮件里写了冬季学期资助新的「款项发放日期」。

words.enDefinition: a list of dates or intervals for releasing money to a recipient

examples.en: The disbursement schedule shows when each of the three payments will reach my account.
examples.zh: 「款项发放时间表」列出了三笔款项分别什么时候到我的账户。

examples.en: I saved the disbursement schedule alongside the email that confirmed my funding amount.
examples.zh: 我把「款项发放时间表」和确认资助金额的邮件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: to release money that has been allocated for a payment or purpose

examples.en: The office said it would disburse funds after it had checked enrolment records.
examples.zh: 办公室说，核对注册记录后会「发放款项」。

examples.en: I asked whether the program would disburse funds in one or two payments.
examples.zh: 我问该项目会分一笔还是两笔「发放款项」。

words.enDefinition: financial aid expected to be credited to an account but not yet applied

examples.en: The bill shows anticipated aid below the total charges for my first term.
examples.zh: 账单在第一学期费用合计下面列出了「预计到账的资助」。

examples.en: My balance changed after the amount listed as anticipated aid was credited.
examples.zh: 「预计到账的资助」划入账户后，我的余额变了。

words.enDefinition: a change to the amount or mix of financial aid recorded for a student

examples.en: The office sent me a notice about an aid adjustment after I dropped a class.
examples.zh: 我退掉一门课之后，办公室发来了「资助金额调整」通知。

examples.en: The new statement explained which term the aid adjustment applied to and why.
examples.zh: 新的报表解释了「资助金额调整」适用于哪个学期，以及调整原因。

words.enDefinition: the combination of grants, scholarships, loans or work opportunities offered to a student

examples.en: My financial aid package included an institutional grant and an offer of student employment.
examples.zh: 我的「整套助学资助」包括学校助学金和一个学生工作机会。

examples.en: I compared the grants and loans in each university's financial aid package before deciding.
examples.zh: 作决定之前，我比较了各大学「整套助学资助」里有哪些助学金和贷款。

words.enDefinition: a notification listing the types and amounts of aid offered to a student

examples.en: The financial aid offer arrived in my portal a week after my admission letter.
examples.zh: 录取信到了一周后，我在平台上收到了「助学资助通知」。

examples.en: I asked which parts of the financial aid offer required a separate response.
examples.zh: 我问「助学资助通知」里的哪些项目需要单独回复。

collocations: respond to a financial aid offer

words.enDefinition: a school office that administers financial assistance for students

examples.en: The financial aid office checked why the grant was missing from my account.
examples.zh: 「助学资助办公室」核查了我的账户里为什么没有那笔助学金。

examples.en: I sent the requested document to the financial aid office before Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我在周五下午前把要求的材料发给了「助学资助办公室」。

words.enDefinition: a person who helps students understand funding choices, eligibility and application records

examples.en: The financial aid adviser explained which documents were still missing from my file.
examples.zh: 「助学资助顾问」说明了我的档案还缺哪些材料。

examples.en: I booked an appointment with a financial aid adviser after receiving the revised bill.
examples.zh: 收到更新的账单后，我预约了「助学资助顾问」。

collocations: meet with a financial aid adviser
speak to a financial aid adviser

words.enDefinition: a request or form submitted to be considered for financial support as a student

examples.en: I saved my financial aid application because I still needed one income document.
examples.zh: 我先存了「助学资助申请」，因为还差一份收入材料。

examples.en: The portal showed when the financial aid application had been received by the office.
examples.zh: 平台显示了办公室收到「助学资助申请」的时间。

words.enDefinition: a formal request to reconsider a decision about a student's financial aid

examples.en: I attached the dates from my original decision letter to the financial aid appeal.
examples.zh: 我在「助学资助复核申请」里附上了原决定信上的日期。

examples.en: The school said a different panel would review my financial aid appeal next week.
examples.zh: 学校说，下周将由另一个小组审核我的「助学资助复核申请」。

collocations: a decision on a financial aid appeal

words.enDefinition: a school's estimated total cost for attending during a period, including tuition and expected expenses

examples.en: The university included an estimate for transport in the cost of attendance for commuters.
examples.zh: 大学在通勤学生的「就读总费用估算」里列了交通费用预估。

examples.en: I compared the cost of attendance for living on campus and renting nearby.
examples.zh: 我比较了住校和在附近租房的「就读总费用估算」。

collocations: include expenses in the cost of attendance

words.enDefinition: a figure used to help determine a student's eligibility for US federal financial aid

examples.en: The US application summary showed my Student Aid Index next to the eligibility information.
examples.zh: 美国资助申请摘要把我的「美国学生资助指数」列在资格信息旁边。

examples.en: I asked the adviser how the Student Aid Index was used in the example.
examples.zh: 我问顾问在这个例子里，「美国学生资助指数」是怎么用的。

words.enDefinition: the part of assessed financial need that remains after available aid has been counted

examples.en: The worksheet showed unmet financial need after all of the offered awards were counted.
examples.zh: 计算表先计入所有获批补助，再显示「未获填补的资助需求」。

examples.en: I asked whether the small grant would reduce my unmet financial need for next term.
examples.zh: 我问这笔小额助学金能否减少下学期「未获填补的资助需求」。

words.enDefinition: financial need established using information about costs and available resources

examples.en: The program assessed demonstrated financial need using the budget and supporting documents I submitted.
examples.zh: 项目根据我提交的预算和证明材料确定「经核定的资助需求」。

examples.en: The award criteria mention demonstrated financial need as well as academic progress.
examples.zh: 奖励标准既提到了「经核定的资助需求」，也提到了学业进展。

words.enDefinition: a tool that estimates the amount a student may pay after applicable grants and scholarships

examples.en: I tried the university's net price calculator before comparing the two offers.
examples.zh: 在比较两份录取通知之前，我试用了大学的「就读净费用计算器」。

examples.en: The net price calculator asked whether I planned to live with my family.
examples.zh: 「就读净费用计算器」问我是否打算和家人一起住。

collocations: an estimate from the net price calculator

words.enDefinition: the academic year or other defined period for which a financial aid award is made

examples.en: The two letters listed the same grant amount for a different award year.
examples.zh: 两封信列出的助学金金额相同，但对应的「资助年度」不同。

examples.en: I selected the wrong award year and had to start a new application.
examples.zh: 我选错了「资助年度」，得重新填写一份申请。

collocations: aid for the next award year

words.enDefinition: the status of meeting requirements to receive a particular kind of student aid

examples.en: The office reviewed my financial aid eligibility after I changed my course load.
examples.zh: 我调整了选课量之后，办公室复核了我的「助学资助资格」。

examples.en: The guide has a table showing how enrolment affects financial aid eligibility in this program.
examples.zh: 指南用一张表说明了注册情况怎样影响该项目的「助学资助资格」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money granted to a person under a particular award

examples.en: The award amount on the letter differed from what appeared in the portal.
examples.zh: 信上的「获批资助金额」和平台上显示的不一样。

examples.en: I checked the award amount before signing the form to accept the scholarship.
examples.zh: 我先核对「获批资助金额」，才签署接受奖学金的表格。

collocations: a change in the award amount

words.enDefinition: a person who receives financial assistance from an aid program

examples.en: Each aid recipient received a separate letter with the dates and payment amounts.
examples.zh: 每位「资助领取人」都收到了一封单独的信，上面写了发放日期和金额。

examples.en: The application asked whether I was an aid recipient in the previous year.
examples.zh: 申请表问我上一年是不是「资助领取人」。

words.enDefinition: an award that is made subject to specified conditions being met

examples.en: The university explained what I still needed to do for the conditional award.
examples.zh: 大学说明了这项「附条件的资助」还有哪些要求需要我满足。

examples.en: My conditional award depended on finishing the required number of credits that term.
examples.zh: 我得修满那个学期要求的学分，才能获得这项「附条件的资助」。

collocations: the terms of a conditional award

words.enDefinition: financial support funded or awarded by the university or college itself

examples.en: The university listed institutional aid separately from government grants on the same page.
examples.zh: 大学在同一个页面上把「学校提供的助学资助」与政府助学金分开列出。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether my funding estimate already included institutional aid for the year.
examples.zh: 顾问问，当年资助金额的估算有没有把「学校提供的助学资助」算进去。

words.enDefinition: money awarded to help a student meet study costs that normally does not need to be repaid

examples.en: The student grant covered most of the equipment I needed for the course.
examples.zh: 「学生助学金」支付了我上这门课所需的大部分设备费用。

examples.en: I found the student grant listed below the loan on my award summary.
examples.zh: 我在资助摘要上看到，贷款下面列的是「学生助学金」。

collocations: the terms of a student grant

words.enDefinition: a grant that helps pay for everyday living expenses during study

examples.en: The living-cost grant helped cover my bus fares and groceries during the placement.
examples.zh: 「生活费助学金」补贴了我实习期间的公交费和食品杂货开销。

examples.en: The funding page lists a living-cost grant separately from support with course fees.
examples.zh: 资助页面把「生活费助学金」和课程费补助分开列出。

words.enDefinition: short-term financial support awarded to a student facing an urgent expense or financial problem

examples.en: The university offered an emergency student grant after my temporary housing fell through.
examples.zh: 我的临时住处没着落后，学校提供了「学生紧急助学金」。

examples.en: The email explained which costs the emergency student grant was designed to cover.
examples.zh: 邮件解释了「学生紧急助学金」用来支付哪些费用。

collocations: apply for an emergency student grant

words.enDefinition: money awarded to support a student's studies, often based on financial circumstances

examples.en: My bursary went towards the travel costs for my first clinical placement.
examples.zh: 我的「助学补助金」用来支付第一次临床实习的交通费。

examples.en: The college notified me about the bursary through my student email account.
examples.zh: 学院通过学生邮箱通知了我「助学补助金」的事。

words.zhGloss: 按经济状况核定的助学金
words.enDefinition: a bursary whose eligibility or amount depends on an assessment of available income or resources
acceptedZhAnswers: 按经济状况核定的助学金

examples.en: The application for a means-tested bursary asked about household income and dependants.
examples.zh: 「按经济状况核定的助学金」申请表问了家庭收入和受抚养人情况。

examples.en: The funding page explains why the means-tested bursary varies from student to student.
examples.zh: 资助页面说明了为什么不同学生领到的「按经济状况核定的助学金」金额不同。

collocations: an application for a means-tested bursary

words.enDefinition: a grant awarded according to assessed financial need

examples.en: The school offered a need-based grant after reviewing the documents in my aid file.
examples.zh: 学校看过我的资助材料后，提供了一笔「经济困难助学金」。

examples.en: The funding table shows whether each need-based grant can be renewed next year.
examples.zh: 资助表标明了每项「经济困难助学金」下一年能否续领。

words.enDefinition: a scholarship based on achievement or ability, such as in academics, arts or athletics

examples.en: She received a merit-based scholarship after submitting her grades and a portfolio.
examples.zh: 提交成绩和作品集后，她获得了一项「按表现评定的奖学金」。

examples.en: The university described how it selects students for its new merit-based scholarship.
examples.zh: 大学介绍了它怎样选拔获得新设「按表现评定的奖学金」的学生。

words.enDefinition: a scholarship that can continue into another term or year if its conditions are met

examples.en: I kept the letter explaining how to maintain my renewable scholarship next year.
examples.zh: 我保存了那封信，上面说明怎样在下一年续领「可续领奖学金」。

examples.en: The offer describes a renewable scholarship that continues after each successful annual review.
examples.zh: 通知介绍了一项「可续领奖学金」，每年评审通过后就能续领。

words.enDefinition: a scholarship awarded for a single period or payment without automatic continuation

examples.en: I used my one-time scholarship to help pay for textbooks and course materials.
examples.zh: 我用「一次性奖学金」补贴了课本和课程资料的费用。

examples.en: The faculty offered a one-time scholarship for students participating in the summer program.
examples.zh: 院系向参加暑期项目的学生提供了「一次性奖学金」。

words.enDefinition: a scholarship that covers only part of the costs of a person's studies

examples.en: The partial scholarship left a tuition balance that my family agreed to cover.
examples.zh: 「部分奖学金」没有付清学费，家里同意承担剩下的部分。

examples.en: I asked which housing expenses were included in the partial scholarship on offer.
examples.zh: 我问可以获发的「部分奖学金」包含哪些住宿费用。

words.enDefinition: a scholarship covering tuition and most or all major costs of attending college, such as room and board

examples.en: The college's full-ride scholarship covered my tuition, residence fees and campus meal plan.
examples.zh: 该学院的「全额就读奖学金」支付了我的学费、宿舍费和校餐计划费用。

examples.en: She asked whether the full-ride scholarship also covered books for the required courses.
examples.zh: 她问「全额就读奖学金」还包不包含必修课的课本费。

words.enDefinition: the process of extending a scholarship into another funding period

examples.en: My scholarship renewal depended on the grades from both terms of the first year.
examples.zh: 我的「奖学金续领」取决于第一年两个学期的成绩。

examples.en: The office sent a reminder about scholarship renewal before final results were posted.
examples.zh: 最终成绩公布前，办公室发来了「奖学金续领」提醒。

words.enDefinition: a document used to confirm that a student accepts a scholarship and its conditions

examples.en: I signed the scholarship acceptance form after reading the conditions in the award letter.
examples.zh: 我读完获奖信上的条件后，签了「奖学金接受确认表」。

examples.en: The portal showed that my scholarship acceptance form had been submitted successfully.
examples.zh: 平台显示，我的「奖学金接受确认表」已经提交成功。

words.enDefinition: the span of time for which funding is provided

examples.en: The funding period for my research award ended before the new semester began.
examples.zh: 我的研究项目的「资助期限」在新学期开学前就结束了。

examples.en: The notice explains which expenses need to fall within the approved funding period.
examples.zh: 通知说明了哪些开支必须发生在获批的「资助期限」内。

words.enDefinition: funding for a student to undertake a research degree or project, often including fees or a stipend

examples.en: The department advertised a research studentship for a project on coastal ecology.
examples.zh: 院系为一项海岸生态项目发布了「研究生培养资助」招募通知。

examples.en: I asked what living allowance came with the research studentship on the website.
examples.zh: 我问网站上的「研究生培养资助」配有多少生活津贴。

words.enDefinition: part or all of a tuition charge that a university agrees not to collect, often as an employment or study benefit

examples.en: My assistantship letter explained how much tuition remission came with the position.
examples.zh: 助教岗位的聘书注明了这个岗位提供多少「学费减免」。

examples.en: The student account showed tuition remission under credits for the autumn term.
examples.zh: 学生账户把「学费减免」列在秋季学期的抵扣项下。

words.enDefinition: approval to move a fee payment to a later date without waiving the charge

examples.en: I requested a fee deferral because my aid would arrive after the deadline.
examples.zh: 助学资助要在截止日过后才到账，所以我申请了「费用缓缴」。

examples.en: The fee deferral notice showed when the remaining tuition payment would be due.
examples.zh: 「费用缓缴」通知写明了剩余学费要在什么时候缴清。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that divides tuition into scheduled payments instead of one payment

examples.en: The tuition installment plan split my bill into four payments across the term.
examples.zh: 「学费分期缴纳计划」把我的账单分成学期内四次缴清。

examples.en: I checked the dates on the tuition installment plan before signing the agreement.
examples.zh: 签协议前，我核对了「学费分期缴纳计划」上的日期。

collocations: enrol in a tuition installment plan
set up a tuition installment plan

words.enDefinition: the last date for paying a particular tuition charge on time

examples.en: I received a reminder about the tuition payment deadline from the accounts office.
examples.zh: 我收到了财务办公室发来的「学费缴纳截止日」提醒。

examples.en: The tuition payment deadline on my corrected bill was a week later.
examples.zh: 我更正后的账单把「学费缴纳截止日」推迟了一周。

words.enDefinition: a bill showing individual education charges separately instead of only a total

examples.en: My sponsor requested an itemized tuition bill before approving the payment to the university.
examples.zh: 资助方在批准向学校付款前，要求我提供「逐项列明的学费账单」。

examples.en: The itemized tuition bill separates the lab fees from the basic course charge.
examples.zh: 「逐项列明的学费账单」把实验费和基本课程费分开。

words.enDefinition: money applied to a student's institutional account that reduces what is owed

examples.en: The refunded lab fee appeared as a student account credit on my statement.
examples.zh: 退回来的实验费在报表上列为「学生账户抵扣款」。

examples.en: A student account credit reduced the amount I needed to pay that month.
examples.zh: 一笔「学生账户抵扣款」减少了我当月要缴的金额。

words.enDefinition: the net amount outstanding or in credit on an account held by a school for a student

examples.en: The student account balance changed after the university posted my first grant payment.
examples.zh: 学校录入我第一笔助学金后，「学生账户余额」变了。

examples.en: I checked my student account balance before calling about the tuition invoice.
examples.zh: 打电话询问学费账单前，我看了「学生账户余额」。

collocations: pay your outstanding student account balance

words.enDefinition: money returned when payments and credits exceed the charges on a student's account

examples.en: The university sent my credit balance refund after the scholarship covered the outstanding fees.
examples.zh: 奖学金抵扣剩余费用后，学校发出了我的「账户结余退款」。

examples.en: I could see the credit balance refund as a separate transaction on my account.
examples.zh: 我能在账户里看到单列的一笔「账户结余退款」。

words.enDefinition: the school office that handles charges, payments and refunds on student accounts

examples.en: The student accounts office sent an updated invoice after checking my payment record.
examples.zh: 「学生缴费办公室」核对我的付款记录后发来了更新的账单。

examples.en: I asked the student accounts office to confirm that the new charge had been removed.
examples.zh: 我请「学生缴费办公室」确认新加的收费已经取消。

collocations: send an invoice to the student accounts office

words.enDefinition: an initial payment toward tuition, often collected before enrolment

examples.en: My tuition deposit appeared as a credit on the first full university bill.
examples.zh: 我的「学费预付款」在学校第一张完整账单上显示为一笔抵扣款。

examples.en: I kept the receipt confirming that the university had received my tuition deposit.
examples.zh: 我留着收据，证明学校已经收到了「学费预付款」。

collocations: credit a tuition deposit to an account

words.enDefinition: enrolment at a study load that meets a school's or aid program's threshold for half-time status

examples.en: The aid office explained which courses counted toward half-time enrollment in my program.
examples.zh: 资助办公室说明了我这个项目中哪些课程计入「半时注册」的课业量。

examples.en: My account showed half-time enrollment after the registrar updated my course load for spring.
examples.zh: 教务部门更新春季选课量后，我的账户显示为「半时注册」。

words.enDefinition: to confirm officially that a person is enrolled at a school or on a course

examples.en: The agency asked the university to certify enrollment before releasing the second payment.
examples.zh: 资助机构要求学校先「核证注册状态」，才发放第二笔款项。

examples.en: I asked which office could certify enrollment for the study period on my form.
examples.zh: 我问哪个办公室能为表格上那段就读期「核证注册状态」。

collocations: ask the school to certify enrollment

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount of coursework or number of credits required for a particular status

examples.en: I checked whether my new timetable still met the minimum course load for funding.
examples.zh: 我核对了新课表是否还符合领取资助所需的「最低选课量」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the minimum course load was measured for summer study.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了暑期学习的「最低选课量」怎么算。

collocations: fall below the minimum course load

words.zhGloss: 美国学业进展资助申诉
words.enDefinition: a request to restore US financial aid eligibility after missing satisfactory academic progress requirements
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国学业进展资助申诉

examples.en: The US university sent a checklist of evidence I could include in my SAP appeal.
examples.zh: 美国大学给了我一份清单，列出「美国学业进展资助申诉」可附的证明材料。

examples.en: I submitted the SAP appeal after my academic adviser signed the updated plan.
examples.zh: 学业顾问签署更新后的计划后，我提交了「美国学业进展资助申诉」。

words.enDefinition: a status in which student aid stops because the student no longer meets program requirements

examples.en: The message about aid suspension included the contact details for the appeal office.
examples.zh: 关于「暂停发放资助」的消息附上了受理申诉办公室的联系方式。

examples.en: The adviser explained how aid suspension would affect my next term's account.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「暂停发放资助」会怎样影响我下学期的账户。

words.enDefinition: a status that allows certain students to receive aid temporarily while meeting a plan or conditions

examples.en: My approval letter explained the conditions of financial aid probation for the coming term.
examples.zh: 批准信说明了下学期「助学资助考察期」的条件。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to check the end date of my financial aid probation.
examples.zh: 顾问让我核对「助学资助考察期」的结束日期。

collocations: be placed on financial aid probation
receive aid during financial aid probation

words.enDefinition: in US student aid, the process of returning unearned federal aid when a student withdraws

examples.en: The adviser used a sample calculation to explain the return of Title IV funds.
examples.zh: 顾问用计算示例讲解了「美国联邦助学款退回」流程。

examples.en: My withdrawal notice said that the return of Title IV funds was being calculated.
examples.zh: 退学通知说，学校正在计算「美国联邦助学款退回」的金额。

collocations: calculate the return of Title IV funds
a return of Title IV funds policy
a return of Title IV funds notice

words.enDefinition: to make the sum to be borrowed smaller before the full amount is issued

examples.en: The website showed me where to request permission to reduce a loan amount.
examples.zh: 网站指明了我可以在哪儿申请「调低贷款金额」。

examples.en: The adviser explained when students can reduce a loan amount before it is disbursed.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了学生何时可以在款项发放前「调低贷款金额」。

collocations: ask to reduce a loan amount
choose to reduce a loan amount
reduce a loan amount before disbursement

words.enDefinition: to decide against accepting a proposed loan as part of an offer

examples.en: The portal asked why I wanted to decline a loan from my aid offer.
examples.zh: 平台问我为什么要「拒绝接受贷款」，也就是资助通知里列的这笔借款。

examples.en: I checked whether I could decline a loan without losing the grant listed above it.
examples.zh: 我核实了能否「拒绝接受贷款」，同时保留上一行列出的助学金。

collocations: decline a loan in the portal

words.enDefinition: to formally agree to receive financial assistance offered for study

examples.en: The portal explains how to accept financial aid for the upcoming academic year.
examples.zh: 平台介绍了怎样「接受助学资助」，用于下一学年的学习。

examples.en: I read the conditions before deciding whether to accept financial aid from that program.
examples.zh: 我读了条款后才决定是否「接受助学资助」。

collocations: decide whether to accept financial aid
be ready to accept financial aid

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦学生贷款主借据
words.enDefinition: a US federal student loan document in which the borrower promises repayment and agrees to the terms
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦学生贷款主借据

examples.en: The portal marked my master promissory note as signed but still under review.
examples.zh: 平台显示我的「美国联邦学生贷款主借据」已签署，仍在审核中。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the master promissory note with my loan records.
examples.zh: 我把「美国联邦学生贷款主借据」的副本和贷款记录一起保存。

collocations: terms of a master promissory note

words.enDefinition: a document stating the obligations and terms of a loan for study

examples.en: I asked where the student loan agreement described changes to the repayment schedule.
examples.zh: 我问「学生贷款协议」在哪里说明了还款时间表的变更。

examples.en: The office kept my student loan agreement with the other documents for the award.
examples.zh: 办事处把「学生贷款协议」和这项资助的其他材料放在一起。

collocations: the terms of a student loan agreement

words.zhGloss: 加拿大学生资助总协议
words.enDefinition: a Canadian agreement that sets the terms for receiving and repaying government student loans
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大学生资助总协议

examples.en: The Canadian student funding portal showed my Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement as complete.
examples.zh: 加拿大学生资助平台显示我的「加拿大学生资助总协议」已填写完毕。

examples.en: I asked which version of the Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement applied to my funding.
examples.zh: 我问我的资助适用哪个版本的「加拿大学生资助总协议」。

collocations: sign the Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement
complete the Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement
review the Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement

words.enDefinition: the person or organization that owns the right to collect a particular loan debt

examples.en: The letter listed the loan holder separately from the company collecting my payments.
examples.zh: 信上把「贷款债权持有人」与收取我还款的公司分开列出。

examples.en: I asked whether the loan holder had changed when the account was moved.
examples.zh: 我问账户转移时，「贷款债权持有人」有没有变。

collocations: a notice from the loan holder

words.enDefinition: accumulated interest that has been added to the principal of a loan

examples.en: My statement showed capitalized interest as a separate increase to the principal balance.
examples.zh: 对账单把「计入本金的利息」单列为一笔本金余额增量。

examples.en: The adviser pointed out where the worksheet recorded capitalized interest for the example loan.
examples.zh: 顾问指出了计算表在哪里记录案例贷款中「计入本金的利息」。

words.enDefinition: a student loan status showing that the borrower is recorded as studying under the program's rules

examples.en: The loan portal still showed in-school status after I had finished my course.
examples.zh: 我读完课程后，贷款平台还是显示「贷款账户在读状态」。

examples.en: The school reported my new study dates so my in-school status could be corrected.
examples.zh: 学校申报了新的就读日期，以便更正我的「贷款账户在读状态」。

words.enDefinition: deferment of payments on an existing student loan specifically because the borrower remains enrolled

examples.en: I asked which existing loans were included in the notice of in-school deferment.
examples.zh: 我问「在读期间延期还款」通知包含哪些旧贷款。

examples.en: The lender sent a confirmation after my request for in-school deferment was approved.
examples.zh: 「在读期间延期还款」申请获批后，放贷机构发来了一份确认信息。

words.enDefinition: the current stage or standing of a loan's repayment, as recorded by the provider

examples.en: The loan website updated my repayment status when my last scheduled payment cleared.
examples.zh: 最后一笔计划还款到账后，贷款网站更新了我的「还款状态」。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to bring a statement showing the current repayment status.
examples.zh: 顾问让我带一份能显示当前「还款状态」的对账单。

collocations: review the repayment status of a loan

words.enDefinition: to move into the period when payments on a loan become due

examples.en: The two loans will enter repayment on different dates according to the notices.
examples.zh: 根据通知，两笔贷款会在不同日期「进入还款阶段」。

examples.en: I asked when the account would enter repayment after the school updated my records.
examples.zh: 我问学校更新我的记录后，这个账户什么时候「进入还款阶段」。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a borrower begins the required repayment period

examples.en: I entered the repayment start date in my calendar after reading the notice.
examples.zh: 我看完通知后，把「还款起始日期」填进了日历。

examples.en: The adviser checked whether the repayment start date matched the date in my account.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了「还款起始日期」是否和我账户里显示的日期一致。

words.enDefinition: a temporary postponement of required loan payments while the borrower meets a qualifying condition

examples.en: The loan deferment letter gave a date for when regular payments would resume.
examples.zh: 「延期偿还贷款」通知写了恢复按期还款的日期。

examples.en: I called to check whether the loan deferment had been recorded on my account.
examples.zh: 我打电话核实账户上有没有记录「延期偿还贷款」。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement allowing a borrower to stop or reduce scheduled payments temporarily, often with interest still accruing

examples.en: The lender's letter explained what would happen to interest during loan forbearance.
examples.zh: 放贷机构的信说明了「暂缓或减少贷款还款」期间利息会怎样处理。

examples.en: I asked which monthly payment would be affected by the approved loan forbearance.
examples.zh: 我问获批的「暂缓或减少贷款还款」会影响哪一期月供。

words.enDefinition: support that helps an eligible borrower manage or reduce required loan payments

examples.en: The application for repayment assistance asked for the dates covered by my income records.
examples.zh: 「还款援助」申请表询问了我的收入记录涵盖哪些日期。

examples.en: I received a notice about repayment assistance after the service reviewed my documents.
examples.zh: 服务机构审核我的材料后，我收到了一份「还款援助」通知。

words.enDefinition: the income level above which payments become due under some income-based student loan systems

examples.en: The UK guide showed how the repayment threshold differed between two loan plans.
examples.zh: 英国指南展示了两种贷款计划的「启动还款收入门槛」有何不同。

examples.en: I asked which year's repayment threshold was used on the sample payslip.
examples.zh: 我问工资单样本用的是哪一年的「启动还款收入门槛」。

words.enDefinition: a repayment system in which the amounts due depend on the borrower's income

examples.en: The briefing covered income-contingent repayment alongside a plan with fixed monthly payments.
examples.zh: 说明会同时介绍了「按收入水平还款」和固定月供的方案。

examples.en: The guide illustrates income-contingent repayment using two graduates with different earnings for the year.
examples.zh: 指南以两名年收入不同的毕业生为例介绍了「按收入水平还款」。

words.enDefinition: a group of US federal student loan repayment plans that base payments on income and other factors such as family size

examples.en: The US adviser explained where income-driven repayment appeared in the comparison table.
examples.zh: 美国顾问指明了「美国收入挂钩还款」在对比表里的位置。

examples.en: I saw income-driven repayment listed as a separate heading in the federal loan guide.
examples.zh: 我看到联邦贷款指南把「美国收入挂钩还款」单列为一个标题。

words.enDefinition: a repayment plan using scheduled payments over a set period, typically with amounts that stay the same

examples.en: The standard repayment plan showed the same scheduled payment throughout the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「固定分期还款计划」里，各期的约定还款金额相同。

examples.en: I asked which row compared the standard repayment plan with the extended one.
examples.zh: 我问哪一行对比了「固定分期还款计划」和延长期限的计划。

collocations: payments under a standard repayment plan
compare a standard repayment plan with other options

words.zhGloss: 逐步提高金额的还款计划
words.enDefinition: a repayment plan with payments that begin at a lower amount and rise over time
acceptedZhAnswers: 逐步提高金额的还款计划

examples.en: The graduated repayment plan showed higher payments after each step in the schedule.
examples.zh: 「逐步提高金额的还款计划」每调整到下一档，当期还款就会增加。

examples.en: I compared the second year under a graduated repayment plan with the fixed option.
examples.zh: 我把「逐步提高金额的还款计划」第二年的情况与固定金额的方案进行了比较。

collocations: payments on a graduated repayment plan

words.enDefinition: a repayment plan that gives the borrower a longer period to pay off a loan

examples.en: The extended repayment plan spread those payments over more years in the comparison.
examples.zh: 对比表中，「延长期限还款计划」把这些还款分摊到了更多年份。

examples.en: I asked how the extended repayment plan would appear on a monthly statement.
examples.zh: 我问「延长期限还款计划」会在月度对账单上怎样显示。

collocations: qualify for an extended repayment plan
payments under an extended repayment plan

words.enDefinition: combining several outstanding loans into one new loan, such as combining eligible student loans

examples.en: The guide used a worked example to show how loan consolidation changes the statement.
examples.zh: 指南用一个带计算的示例演示「贷款合并」会怎样改变对账单。

examples.en: The office confirmed which loans were included in my request for loan consolidation.
examples.zh: 办公室确认了我的「贷款合并」申请包含哪些贷款。

words.zhGloss: 免除学生贷款偿还义务
words.enDefinition: release from paying some or all of a student loan under a qualifying program
acceptedZhAnswers: 免除学生贷款偿还义务

examples.en: The webinar explained one program for student loan forgiveness after qualifying public service.
examples.zh: 网络讲座介绍了一项面向符合公共服务条件人员的「免除学生贷款偿还义务」计划。

examples.en: I asked which office verified employment for this student loan forgiveness program.
examples.zh: 我问这个「免除学生贷款偿还义务」计划由哪个办公室核实就业情况。

words.enDefinition: release from all or part of a loan obligation because a recognized event or condition applies

examples.en: The notice explained why a loan discharge was granted in the sample case.
examples.zh: 通知解释了为什么示例案例获批「解除贷款偿还义务」。

examples.en: My adviser showed me where the letter stated the effective date of the loan discharge.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看，信里哪儿写着「解除贷款偿还义务」的生效日期。

words.enDefinition: a loan whose borrower has missed a scheduled payment and has not caught up

examples.en: The report marked a delinquent loan even though the latest payment had been sent.
examples.zh: 尽管最新一笔还款已发出，报告仍标记了一笔「拖欠还款的贷款」。

examples.en: The adviser explained what could bring the delinquent loan back into good standing.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了怎样才能使「拖欠还款的贷款」恢复到正常还款状态。

words.zhGloss: 美国违约学生贷款恢复计划
words.enDefinition: a process for bringing a defaulted US federal student loan out of default by meeting specified payment requirements
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国违约学生贷款恢复计划

examples.en: The US loan servicer listed loan rehabilitation separately from consolidation in the guide.
examples.zh: 美国的贷款服务机构在指南里把「美国违约学生贷款恢复计划」与贷款合并分开介绍。

examples.en: I asked who could explain the sample agreement for loan rehabilitation in the handbook.
examples.zh: 我问谁能讲解手册中「美国违约学生贷款恢复计划」的协议样本。

words.enDefinition: an information session or module covering a student borrower's responsibilities and repayment when leaving school

examples.en: I completed exit counseling online after reading the message from the student aid office.
examples.zh: 读完资助办公室的消息后，我在网上完成了「离校前贷款说明」。

examples.en: The exit counseling page included links to my loan balances and repayment information.
examples.zh: 「离校前贷款说明」页面有查看贷款余额和还款信息的链接。

words.enDefinition: an information session or module explaining loan terms and obligations before a student borrows

examples.en: The school showed me where to find entrance counseling in the student portal.
examples.zh: 学校指给我看了学生平台上「首次借款前贷款说明」的位置。

examples.en: The entrance counseling module included a section about keeping track of what I borrowed.
examples.zh: 「首次借款前贷款说明」里有一节讲怎样记下自己借了哪些款项。

words.enDefinition: a record showing a loan's balance and activity such as charges, interest and payments

examples.en: I downloaded my loan statement just before changing the email address on file.
examples.zh: 我在修改登记邮箱前下载了「贷款对账单」。

examples.en: The newest loan statement showed that my last payment had cleared on Thursday.
examples.zh: 最新的「贷款对账单」显示，我上一笔还款在周四已经入账。

words.enDefinition: the dates or duration of study for which a school or program assesses funding

examples.en: The Canadian application asked which study period the funding request was for.
examples.zh: 加拿大申请表问这次资助申请对应哪个「就读期」。

examples.en: I used the dates in my enrolment letter to confirm the study period.
examples.zh: 我根据注册证明上的日期确认了「就读期」。

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦学生资助申请表
words.enDefinition: the Free Application for Federal Student Aid used to apply for US federal student aid
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦学生资助申请表
acceptedEnVariants: Free Application for Federal Student Aid

examples.en: The US financial aid office confirmed that it had received my FAFSA data.
examples.zh: 美国助学资助办公室确认已收到我的「美国联邦学生资助申请表」数据。

examples.en: I checked which award year my FAFSA was for before making any changes.
examples.zh: 我在更改之前先核对了「美国联邦学生资助申请表」是哪个资助年度的。

collocations: make a correction to your FAFSA

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦学生资助申请摘要
words.enDefinition: a US record summarizing information and preliminary aid calculations after a FAFSA has been processed
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦学生资助申请摘要

examples.en: My FAFSA Submission Summary showed that one of my contact fields was incomplete.
examples.zh: 我的「美国联邦学生资助申请摘要」显示，有一项联系方式没有填完整。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to compare the FAFSA Submission Summary with the school's offer.
examples.zh: 顾问让我把「美国联邦学生资助申请摘要」与学校的资助通知核对。

words.zhGloss: 高校非联邦资助申请表
words.enDefinition: a College Board application used by some institutions to award their own financial aid
acceptedZhAnswers: 高校非联邦资助申请表

examples.en: The US college listed the CSS Profile separately from its federal aid form.
examples.zh: 美国那所学院把「高校非联邦资助申请表」和联邦助学表格分开列出。

examples.en: I asked the aid office whether the CSS Profile applied to my program.
examples.zh: 我问资助办公室，我选的项目是否使用「高校非联邦资助申请表」。

words.enDefinition: a student classified as dependent under an aid program's rules, often requiring parental financial information

examples.en: The US worksheet used a dependent student to show where parental income was entered.
examples.zh: 美国的计算表用「受抚养学生」的案例展示了父母收入填在哪儿。

examples.en: The guide explains when someone counts as a dependent student for that aid program.
examples.zh: 指南解释了在该资助项目中，哪些情况下某人算「受抚养学生」。

collocations: classify someone as a dependent student

words.enDefinition: a student treated as independent for an aid application under the program's eligibility rules

examples.en: The form asked different questions when I selected independent student in the example.
examples.zh: 我在样表上选择「独立学生」后，显示的问题变了。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the program decides whether someone is an independent student.
examples.zh: 顾问说明该项目怎样判定一个人是否属于「独立学生」。

words.enDefinition: a review that checks information on a student's aid application against supporting records

examples.en: My financial aid verification was pending because the school still needed one document.
examples.zh: 我的「助学资助资料核实」还没完成，因为学校还缺一份材料。

examples.en: I asked which figures the office was checking during financial aid verification this week.
examples.zh: 我问办公室这周做「助学资助资料核实」时在核对哪些数字。

words.enDefinition: an administrative flag that delays processing or payment of a student's aid until an issue is resolved

examples.en: The portal listed a financial aid hold after the office requested a new document.
examples.zh: 办公室要求补交材料后，平台显示「助学资助暂缓处理」。

examples.en: I asked how long the financial aid hold would remain after I submitted the form.
examples.zh: 我问交表以后，「助学资助暂缓处理」的状态还会持续多久。

words.enDefinition: a letter confirming that a person or organization will cover specified costs for a student

examples.en: My funding agency sent a sponsor letter stating which fees it would pay.
examples.zh: 资助机构发来「资助方承诺函」，写明会支付哪些费用。

examples.en: The university asked for a sponsor letter covering the dates of the entire term.
examples.zh: 大学要求提供一份涵盖整个学期日期的「资助方承诺函」。

collocations: check the dates on a sponsor letter

words.enDefinition: a process in which a school sends eligible charges directly to a student's sponsor or other payer

examples.en: The college used third-party billing because my employer was paying the tuition fee.
examples.zh: 因为我的雇主要付学费，学院采用了「向第三方开具账单」。

examples.en: The office listed the sponsor's invoice under third-party billing in the student portal.
examples.zh: 财务办公室把资助方发票列在学生平台的「向第三方开具账单」栏目。

words.enDefinition: a written agreement specifying what a sponsor will fund and any terms of that support

examples.en: The sponsorship agreement listed course fees but did not cover my travel costs.
examples.zh: 「资助协议」列了课程费，没有包括我的交通费。

examples.en: I saved the signed sponsorship agreement before forwarding a copy to the university.
examples.zh: 我保存了签好的「资助协议」，再给学校转发了一份副本。

collocations: the terms of a sponsorship agreement

words.enDefinition: repayment to a student or employee of eligible tuition they have already paid

examples.en: My employer asked for the tuition receipt before processing tuition reimbursement for the course.
examples.zh: 雇主在办理这门课的「学费报销」前，要求我提交学费收据。

examples.en: I checked when the tuition reimbursement would appear in my employee payment record.
examples.zh: 我查了「学费报销」什么时候会出现在员工付款记录里。

words.enDefinition: a grant to help a student with the cost of arranging care for a child or other dependent

examples.en: The dependent care grant covered part of the nursery fees during my evening classes.
examples.zh: 「受抚养人照护补助」支付了我上晚课期间一部分托儿费。

examples.en: I asked which documents to send with the application for a dependent care grant.
examples.zh: 我问申请「受抚养人照护补助」要附哪些材料。

collocations: apply for a dependent care grant
eligibility for a dependent care grant

words.enDefinition: financial assistance for eligible students' costs connected with disability or access needs

examples.en: The disability-related grant helped me pay for accessible course materials this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期，「残障相关助学金」补贴了无障碍课程资料的费用。

examples.en: The office explained which expenses the disability-related grant could cover during my studies.
examples.zh: 办公室说明了我就读期间，「残障相关助学金」能覆盖哪些开支。

words.enDefinition: a set payment to support a student or researcher while carrying out research

examples.en: The research stipend arrived at the start of each month during my project.
examples.zh: 做项目期间，我每个月月初都收到「研究津贴」。

examples.en: My funding letter listed the research stipend separately from money for project expenses.
examples.zh: 资助函把「研究津贴」和项目开支经费分开列出。

collocations: the amount of a research stipend

words.enDefinition: an approved amount a student may earn through eligible work under a financial aid program

examples.en: The work-study award appeared in my aid package before I found an eligible job.
examples.zh: 在我找到符合条件的工作之前，资助方案就列出了「勤工助学获批额度」。

examples.en: I asked whether the work-study award showed my earning limit for the current year.
examples.zh: 我问「勤工助学获批额度」是不是显示了我今年可以挣多少。

collocations: the amount of a work-study award

words.enDefinition: the highest amount of funding allowed under a particular award

examples.en: The funding page lists an award cap for each type of summer project.
examples.zh: 资助页面列出了每类暑期项目的「资助金额上限」。

examples.en: Our revised budget stayed under the award cap printed in the application guide.
examples.zh: 调整后的预算没有超过申请指南所列的「资助金额上限」。

words.enDefinition: the difference between expected costs and money already available to cover them

examples.en: The revised travel estimate left a small funding gap for my placement abroad.
examples.zh: 新的交通费估算给我的海外实习留下了一小笔「资金缺口」。

examples.en: I calculated the funding gap after the university confirmed my grant for next year.
examples.zh: 学校确认了我下一年的助学金后，我算出了「资金缺口」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum total an eligible borrower can borrow under a loan program across multiple periods

examples.en: The federal aid guide explains how the aggregate loan limit differs from the annual limit.
examples.zh: 联邦资助指南解释了「学生贷款累计上限」和年度上限的区别。

examples.en: I asked how my previous borrowing counted toward the aggregate loan limit in the example.
examples.zh: 我问在这个例子里，我以前借的钱是怎么计入「学生贷款累计上限」的。

collocations: stay below the aggregate loan limit
count toward the aggregate loan limit

words.enDefinition: a scholarship that covers all tuition charges while leaving other costs to be paid separately

examples.en: The full-tuition scholarship covered classes, but I still needed funding for rent and meals.
examples.zh: 「全额学费奖学金」付了上课的费用，但房租和餐费还需要另外筹措。

examples.en: I checked whether the full-tuition scholarship applied to the summer courses I planned to take.
examples.zh: 我核实了「全额学费奖学金」是否适用于我打算选的暑期课程。

words.enDefinition: financial support that helps a student cover eligible travel connected with study or research

examples.en: The travel bursary paid for my return train ticket to the research conference.
examples.zh: 「差旅补助金」支付了我参加学术会议的往返火车票。

examples.en: I kept the receipts the department needed to process my travel bursary application.
examples.zh: 我留着院系处理「差旅补助金」申请所需的收据。

words.enDefinition: the most a person can borrow under a particular loan program in one year

examples.en: The annual loan limit in my offer was smaller than the total for my degree.
examples.zh: 资助通知中的「年度贷款上限」小于我整个学位的贷款总上限。

examples.en: I checked whether both semesters counted toward the annual loan limit in the funding guide.
examples.zh: 我查了资助指南，看看「年度贷款上限」是不是两个学期合计的。

collocations: count toward the annual loan limit
